g.text: Fictional workshop subcase · proposed controls; no observed outage or assessed numeric probability
No executed demonstration supplied. Secure restoration is an acceptance condition; missing probability is not
Runbook existence does not establish that operators can restore service. Technical behavior and human usability
No probability-impact score is plotted because no assessed scales/values were supplied. Define relevant failure conditions, demonstrate
recovery, validate operator use and obtain actual acceptance. A document is not a proven control.
